<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Ottenibili

Le soglie derivano da osservazioni della comunità. I contributi privati possono contare se l’opzione è attiva.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Creare un repository con **16 stelle**; i livelli superiori dipendono dalle stelle dello stesso repository.

**Livelli:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (stelle del repository).

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Essere autore di **2 pull request unite**.

**Livelli:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (PR unite dell’autore).

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Scrivere insieme commit in **1 PR unita**, con un corretto `Co-authored-by`.

**Livelli:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (PR unite con coautori).

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Ottenere **2 risposte accettate** in Discussions. In `github.com/orgs/community` disattivato dal 2024-02-06.

**Livelli:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (risposte accettate).

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

Chiudere un’issue o PR **entro 5 minuti** dall’apertura.

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

Unire la propria PR **senza revisione del codice**; le regole ufficiali dettagliate non sono pubblicate.

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="public-sponsor"></a>
### Public Sponsor

<img src="../assets/badges/public-sponsor-default.png" width="96" alt="Public Sponsor">

Sponsorizzare pubblicamente uno sviluppatore o un’organizzazione tramite **GitHub Sponsors**.

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S27](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S19](https://github.com/sponsors) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ Storici

Questi eventi sono conclusi. I premi esistenti possono restare; nuovi contributi non li sbloccano.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Contribuire a un repository idoneo nell’**istantanea Arctic Code Vault del 2020-02-02**. Evento chiuso.

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

Scrivere un commit in una specifica versione usata da **NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. Evento concluso.

[Esempio reale](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Etichette del profilo

Gli Highlights sono etichette separate di programmi e account; la disponibilità dipende dal programma.

| Nome | Stato | Condizione | Fonti |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Ottenibili | Utilizzare GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Ottenibili | Partecipare al Developer Program e creare un’app con l’API GitHub. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Ottenibili | Segnalare una vulnerabilità GitHub idonea tramite Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Ottenibili | Partecipare a GitHub Campus Experts; controllare le regole attuali delle candidature. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Ottenibili | Ricevere un riconoscimento in un avviso di sicurezza accettato nella GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Ottenibili | Essere selezionati per GitHub Stars; le stelle di un repository non bastano. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Storici | Etichetta storica delle risposte accettate; sostituzione con Galaxy Brain segnalata nel 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |

### Il caso Proxima

Schermate e schede coincidono: Pioneer — prototipo M0; Staffshipper — istanza M8; Staffuser — ingresso della squadra.

| Traguardo | Account | UTC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Proxima Pioneer](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2023-06-01T17:34:35Z |
| [Proxima Staffshipper](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2024-08-21T22:28:27Z |
| [Proxima Staffuser](https://github.com/timrogers?achievement=proxima-staffuser&tab=achievements) | @timrogers | 2023-08-16T18:28:07Z |

«inaccessible» significa mancanza di accesso all’evento. Staffshipper: 2024-08-22 nella schermata, 2024-08-21 in UTC.
